sections.title: Colourful Refresh
items: All colour inputs have been refined, and now have a consistent look
As well as this, you are now able to save a colour to a colour pallete to quickly apply that colour to a variety of things.
-- This pallete shows your 10 most recent saved colours

sections.title: Clock Changes
items: You can now adjust the font and colour of the large central clock!
Collapsed it and don't know how to get the large clock back? - just click on the smaller, collapsed clock in the top left and tap the 'Expanded' button!

sections.title: Other Changes
items: - The 'people' tab can now be reverted to show a list of people instead of a grid

sections.title: Closing Notes
items: Please report any bugs or request changes through the 'Feedback' button in the settings. Thank you for using Modern Classroom!
